claim: The sample opens with two useful alerts and saves no demo data
sandbox: fresh browser context opens /?demo=1; two alerts and recommendations render; no demo or product storage key is created

claim: Demo mode does not read, send, or change real checker and license data
sandbox: seed real license, verdict, preset, and release keys; open /?demo=1; edit and reset; assert no protected-key read, no third-party request, and unchanged sentinels

claim: Chosen video and caption files are processed on the device and are not uploaded
where: landing page, checker, privacy policy, README
sandbox: enter the real checker from the demo, scan shipped files, and assert no request carries media or leaves the same origin

claim: Scanning plus CSV and JSON exports work without an account or purchase
sandbox: fresh demo context downloads both export formats and contains no sign-in, license, or purchase control

claim: Protected regions are saved in browser storage only when the user chooses Save
sandbox: fresh context adds a keyboard region; storage stays empty before Save; after Save only the local protected-region key changes

claim: The public site uses no advertising, behavioral analytics, or third-party font requests
sandbox: visit every route with the GitHub release branch enabled; allow only same-origin and api.github.com release requests; reject analytics and external font origins

claim: The browser demo works offline after the first visit
where: landing download section, README demo documentation
sandbox: clean service-worker state; visit /?demo=1; go offline; reload with the banner and two alerts

claim: The sample review exports a CSV with every alert
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 download; assert CSV header and exactly two alert rows

claim: The sample review exports a free JSON project report
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 download without license state; parse the report and assert two alerts

claim: The checker reads SRT and positioned WebVTT captions
sandbox: scan the shipped video with SRT and positioned WebVTT fixtures and observe both captions checked

claim: Unicode caption text remains intact in alerts and exports
sandbox: open the shipped Arabic and Japanese demo; assert visible text and byte-for-byte text in CSV

claim: The checker flags possible face and visually busy overlap on the device
sandbox: scan labelled portrait and dense-video fixtures from clean pages and observe one alert for each, repeated in the full suite

claim: Each sample alert includes a safer caption position
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 asserts every rendered alert has a move recommendation

claim: A protected region can be marked with a pointer or keyboard
sandbox: fresh checker adds one region with keyboard controls and another with a pointer drag

claim: The download page stores recent GitHub release data to reduce requests
sandbox: controlled clock and in-memory storage; two loads make one GitHub API request and reuse the stored response

claim: If release data is unavailable, the page links to GitHub Releases without a console error
sandbox: block and separately return an empty GitHub release response; assert release links and zero console errors

claim: The download page selects a matching operating system and architecture when available
sandbox: controlled macOS, Windows, and Linux release assets across x64 and ARM64; assert only compatible packages are selected

claim: Current releases provide macOS, Windows, and Linux builds with published checksums
sandbox: GitHub latest release; resolve every supported platform and architecture, HEAD each asset, compare manifest hashes, and hash one downloaded installer

claim: Terminal installers compare downloads with their published SHA-256 values
sandbox: temporary fake release and download tools; prove the shell installer accepts a match and rejects a mismatch; inspect the PowerShell mismatch guard

claim: Current desktop builds have no publisher signature
sandbox: latest Windows installer and release workflow; assert an empty PE certificate directory and no signing configuration

claim: The automated benchmark uses a labelled 30-video set
sandbox: repository fixtures; assert 30 unique encoded videos, critical/control labels, ten-minute metadata, and multiple languages

claim: The software is licensed under MIT
sandbox: fresh repository checkout; assert LICENSE contains the canonical MIT grant and package metadata names MIT
